Class SnapshotMessage

java.lang.Object
mesos.network.server.SnapshotMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ServerMessage
public class SnapshotMessage extends Object implements ServerMessage
Full model snapshot sent from server to client after every state change. The client renders entirely from this object — no partial-update logic needed. Built via from(Game) on the server; deserialized on the client.
